recognize_zh: 這是一張訊息傳導示意圖而非形態圖：圖A顯示未受抗原刺激時 TC21 經 Igα/Igβ 活化 PI3K（tonic BCR signaling），圖B顯示抗原結合後 LYN→SYK→BTK→PLCγ2 路徑，並標出 fostamatinib、GS-1101（idelalisib）、ibrutinib 的抑制位置。
features: Schematic diagram, not a morphologic image
Panel A: antigen-independent (tonic) BCR signaling via TC21 recruiting PI3K p85/p110delta and p110alpha
Panel B: antigen-bound BCR with Igalpha/Igbeta ITAM phosphorylation, LYN and SYK activation
Downstream PI3K (PIP2 to PIP3, AKT), BTK, PLCgamma2 leading to PKCbeta/IKK/NF-kB and Ca2+/NFAT
Drug targets marked: fostamatinib (SYK), GS-1101/idelalisib (PI3Kdelta), ibrutinib (BTK)
describe_en: This is a schematic figure (Wiestner, Hematology 2012) illustrating upstream B-cell receptor (BCR) signaling relevant to CLL. Panel A depicts tonic, antigen-independent signaling in which TC21 associated with Igalpha/Igbeta activates PI3K isoforms. Panel B depicts antigen-induced signaling with LYN- and SYK-mediated ITAM phosphorylation, followed by PI3Kdelta/AKT and BTK/PLCgamma2 activation, leading to NF-kB and NFAT pathways. Inhibitor sites for fostamatinib (SYK), GS-1101 (idelalisib, PI3Kdelta) and ibrutinib (BTK) are indicated. No morphologic interpretation is applicable.
